lines.text: You decide something on a call. LokalBot records it on your Mac, and no bot joins.
Seconds after you hang up, it's in your notes, linked to the moment it was said.
Later, one search brings it back, along with what you saw on screen.
Start a sentence in any app, and autocomplete finishes it.
Your AI agents can ask for it too.
And the timeline keeps the whole day in order.
LokalBot. Your personal context engine. Local by default, free, and open source.

spoken.text: Write a note telling the team where the offsite is, and when.
